device.description: The block device path where LUKSv1 metadata is stored.

slots.description: A list of metadata slots to manage or verify. Each entry defines a slot number and UUID associated with specific metadata (e.g., boot scripts, network config). Items correspond to the -s/--slot and -u/--uuid parameters of luksmeta commands.

slots.items.description: Placeholder to satisfy schema flattening; see actual item structure below.

force.description: If true, enables the -f/--force flag, suppressing interactive prompts for dangerous operations like init, nuke, or wipe.
